extensionDescription.message: Hand browser downloads to Correntra and capture accessible video and audio.

browserIntegrationDescription.message: Hand downloads and detected media to Correntra.

noMedia.message: Play a video or music track; detected choices will appear here.

useSiteSession.message: Use browser session for media downloads

useSiteSessionDescription.message: Forwards your site cookies to the download engine; greatly improves success on YouTube, Facebook and Instagram. Only the setting is stored; cookies are sent per download.

rightsReminder.message: Download only content you own or are allowed to save.

permissionRequired.message: Site access is required for browser integration.

permissionDenied.message: Permission was not granted; browser downloads stay unchanged.

candidateExpired.message: This media address expired. Play it again to detect a fresh choice.

sessionPermissionDenied.message: Session permission was declined; continuing without it.

appUnavailable.message: Correntra app is unavailable. The browser keeps the download.

onboardingBody.message: Turn on Browser integration below. Downloads and detected media will then be handed to Correntra instead of the browser.
